_comment: Expected PickerRead values per fixture, asserted by tests/chatgpt-picker-reader.test.js. Fixtures are live ChatGPT captures serialized with src/picker-serializer.js (computed inert + display/visibility written back as attributes; script/svg/use/canvas bodies stripped). Each row records its capture in _provenance.

2026-09-05-gpt6-chat-family-expanded.htm._provenance: Reconstructed from the native-extension probe gpt6-native-probe-selection.json (yoetz-owned Chat tab, 2026-09-05, run 20260905T144315Z_b9ff4d). NOT a live CDP serializer capture — CDP WS upgrades were wedged. Replace with a live capture when CDP recovers.
_notes: Live labels for yz-a8c.2: family Latest CHECKED, GPT-5.6 Sol / GPT-5.5 unchecked; effort slider Pro 5 of 5 verified; closed pill '6 Pro' (effort only, no family token).
Without the isFamilyOptionLabel Latest acceptance, the reader drops the Latest radio and reports checked_count=0 on this fixture.
Account effort quota exhausted (Limit reached until 2026-10-01): all four tier rows carry aria-disabled=true + data-disabled; none is checked, so effort.label is null and effort.disabled is true.
Tier rows carry BOTH aria-label and visible text (design assumption 'aria-label only' was wrong as of this capture; isFamilyOptionLabel on text still excludes them from the family read).
Each tier row is wrapped in a tooltip <span data-state=closed>; pickerSurfaceIsOpen must not treat that wrapper as closing the row — the surface root has data-state=open.
Simple view (Power slider, 'Instant, 1 of 1.') is inert; the [role=slider] has aria-valuemin=aria-valuemax=0 and must never be read as the effort control.

Select-model toggle is inside an aria-hidden=true, inert wrapper with aria-expanded=true; ChatGPT now persists the expanded state, so the collapsed shape from 2026-09-01 is no longer reproducible on this account.

2026-09-06-gpt6-chat-live-capture.html._provenance: Live capture via dump_picker_html through the native-messaging channel (yoetz-owned Chat tab, 2026-09-06, run 20260906T124313Z_cc0224; content-script serializer, picker already open from the run's model_selection phase, opened_by_us=false). Reader values asserted above verified with readPicker on this file.
_notes: First live serializer capture: Latest CHECKED, GPT-5.6 Sol / GPT-5.5 unchecked; effort slider Pro (valuenow 4 of 0..4, 'Pro, 5 of 5.').
Captured 10778 bytes; real Radix incidental structure retained (inert attributes on descendants, tooltip wrappers absent in this surface unlike the quota-locked fixture).

2026-09-28-gpt6-chat-live-capture.html._provenance: Live capture from the preserved yz-c1l recipe tab (run 20260928T154808Z_35123c, 2026-09-28): picker opened via the extension's own synthetic activation gesture over CDP (focus + pointerdown/mousedown/pointerup/mouseup/click on the 'Select ChatGPT model' composer trigger), serialized in-page with picker-serializer.js. Captured in the DEFAULT effort view; the family view was verified live (toggle click swaps inert: family radios readable, slider inert) but not serialized. Reader values asserted above verified with readPicker on this file.
_notes: yz-c1l drift: the picker now opens into a split-view design — effort view ('Select model' view-toggle menuitem with data-model-picker-view-toggle, 'Power' slider row with data-reasoning-slider, status 'Pro, 5 of 5.') with the family view mounted but inert + aria-hidden; clicking the toggle swaps which view is inert (no aria-expanded/data-state/aria-controls on the toggle, so nav.expanded stays false).

Family read is empty here BY CONTRACT: inert family rows are never reported (fail-closed); family.label falls back to the toggle text '6Pro'. The driver reaches the family view via the viewToggle click / revealFamily pointer path.
The inert effort slider's attributes stay readable in the family view (sliderEffortSnapshot has no inert gate), so the family-view read still carries effort.label Pro for the combined verification.
GPT-5.5 radio label gained a 'Leaving on October 14' deprecation suffix; isFamilyOptionLabel still matches on the /^gpt\b/i anchor.

2026-10-08-gpt6-family-fresh-chat.html._provenance: Live capture 2026-10-08 on the personal Chrome profile (ext_937d13fd52980082ed530899), extension 0.5.81.1: a fresh https://chatgpt.com/ background tab opened over CDP in the same browser context, picker opened with the extension's synthetic activation gesture, toggled to the family view, serialized in-page with picker-serializer.js. Run 20261008T052001Z_624819 failed closed with model_family_not_found on this shape.
_notes: 2026-10-08 drift: on a fresh new-chat page the GPT-6 Chat family radio is labeled 'GPT-6'; on an existing conversation page the same first radio still read 'Latest' (captured the same minute). Sol and GPT-5.5 rows are unchanged, so 'GPT-6' is the target family and Sol stays refused.

2026-10-09-enterprise-family-view-medium._provenance: Live capture 2026-10-09 on the enterprise Chrome profile (ext_b71b20752c525505b0ee85cf, read-only, nothing sent): dump-picker on the kept tab of run 20261009T112551Z_766fb4, which had failed closed in model_selection with effort_control_not_found. The capture's own open activated the view toggle, so this is the family view; reader values verified with readPicker on this file.
_notes: Same split-view markup as the personal 2026-10-08 capture; only the effort differs: the slider reads 'Medium, 2 of 5.' (Pro is 5 of 5) where the personal account persists Pro.

The driver therefore takes the effort-move path, and the picker now reopens into the last active view: close + reopen stayed in this family view with the slider inert. Clicking the checked GPT-6 radio returns to the effort view with the menu open (live trace 2026-10-09); the fake-page test 'split-view picker that reopens into the family view…' pins the selection contract.
